company.name: Chaos
company.shortDescription: Chaos is a defense technology company that develops advanced sensing, detection, and communication technologies for the military sectors.
company.description: Chaos Industries offers a technology portfolio centered on its Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN) architecture that enables time-synchronous sensing, detection, communications, and effects. Its flagship platform, HYDRA, harnesses the CDN framework to deliver software-defined multi-domain capabilities across land, sea, and air environments while integrating with existing infrastructure under constrained conditions. The company serves defense, government, and industrial sectors, providing scalable and mobile solutions designed for complex operational settings.

productsAndServices.description: A technology platform that achieves precise time synchronization to enhance sensing, detection, and effects for defense and critical industries.
productsAndServices.name: Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN)

productsAndServices.description: A multi-application platform powered by CDN that offers land, sea, and air detection, communications, and electronic effects through software-defined capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: HYDRA
